title: Candidate findings
description:
Written by `qa-agent` from the session log alone. These are proposals, not defects: nothing here has been accepted yet, and the file name says so.

qa-agent never touched the app, so it has no transcript of its own to defend. That is the entire reason this step is a separate agent rather than a final section of the user-agent's output (DESIGN.md section 1).

session_digest.description: Digest of the session.jsonl these were derived from.

findings.description: May be empty. An empty candidate set is a legitimate outcome and must not be treated as a failed run -- the opposite assumption is what produces invented findings.

coverage_note.description: What the session did not reach, so that absence of findings in an area is not read as evidence of quality there.
